provenance: Reverse-engineered and standardized cardiac rescue telemetry specification

0x01.label: AED Powered On
0x01.description: AED device powered on and began optical transmission.

0x02.label: Self-Test Passed
0x02.description: Internal hardware circuitry and capacitor self-test completed successfully.

0x03.label: Self-Test Failed - Service Required
0x03.description: Internal diagnostic error detected. Device not ready for patient rescue.

0x10.label: Electrode Pads Disconnected
0x10.description: Defibrillation pads connector or patient contact is open-circuit.

0x11.label: Electrode Pads Connected
0x11.description: Pads detected and skin-electrode contact impedance is within clinical range.

0x20.label: Analyzing Heart Rhythm
0x20.description: ECG algorithm actively analyzing patient rhythm. Stand clear of patient.

0x21.label: Motion Detected - Stop Patient Movement
0x21.description: Movement artifact detected during rhythm analysis.

0x30.label: Shock Advised - Stand Clear
0x30.description: Shockable rhythm (VF / Pulseless VT) confirmed. Preparing defibrillation.

0x31.label: No Shock Advised
0x31.description: Non-shockable rhythm detected. Check patient responsiveness.

0x32.label: Capacitor Charging
0x32.description: High voltage defibrillator capacitor charging in progress.

0x33.label: Shock Armed - Press Flashing Shock Button
0x33.description: Capacitor fully charged. Visual and auditory alarm active awaiting user button press.

0x34.label: Shock Delivered
0x34.description: Biphasic defibrillation shock discharge successfully delivered to patient.

0x40.label: Start CPR / Chest Compressions
0x40.description: Voice prompt instructed rescuer to immediately begin CPR.

0x41.label: CPR Metronome Active
0x41.description: Audio metronome pacing chest compressions at 100-120 bpm.

0x42.label: Pause CPR - Re-evaluating Rhythm
0x42.description: 2-minute CPR cycle finished. Rescuer instructed to pause compressions.

0x50.label: Low Battery Warning
0x50.description: AED battery reserve level below 15% capacity.

0xFF.label: AED Powered Off
0xFF.description: AED device powered off. Optical telemetry session terminated.

defaultUnknownEvent.label: Unknown AED Telemetry Frame
defaultUnknownEvent.description: Unrecognized telemetry packet. Byte payload preserved verbatim for audit inspection.
